title: Implement BFS and DFS traversal of a graph represented as an adjacency list
hint: BFS uses a Queue and visited set; DFS uses recursion or a Stack with a visited set to avoid revisiting nodes.

title: Detect a cycle in a directed graph
hint: Run DFS tracking a recursion-stack (visiting) set alongside visited; reaching a node already in the current path means a cycle.

title: Perform a topological sort of a directed acyclic graph (DAG)
hint: Use Kahn's algorithm with in-degree counts and a queue, or DFS pushing nodes onto a stack after visiting all their neighbours.

title: Count the number of connected components / islands in a grid (Number of Islands)
hint: Loop over cells and on each unvisited land cell, increment the count and flood fill with DFS or BFS marking connected land as visited.
